welcome.title: Ready to play
welcome.headline: Use your phone as the controller.
welcome.description: Join the room on the TV, then tap A/B/C/D to lock in your answer.

join.title: Enter your details
join.headline: Enter your details
join.description: Your name appears on the TV scoreboard. Your quiz code is shown on the host screen.
join.footerHint: Tip: keep this page open while you play.

waiting.title: Waiting for host
waiting.headline: You're in.
waiting.description: Waiting for the host to start the first round.
waiting.cardHint: When the round begins, your answer buttons will appear here automatically.

answer.title: Tap A / B / C / D
answer.questionSub: Pick A, B, C or D
answer.tapHint: Your first tap locks your answer.

endOfRound.title: Your stats
endOfRound.headline: Nice one.
endOfRound.description: Here's your progress so far. Next round will start on the TV.

endOfGame.title: Game over
endOfGame.headline: Thanks for playing.
endOfGame.description: Want another go? Return to the start screen and join a new room code.

errors.enterNameAndCode: Please enter your name and the quiz code shown on the TV.
errors.rejoinRoom: Connection lost. Please rejoin the room.
errors.connectionLostRetry: Connection lost. Please check your internet and try rejoining.
